cheapest_decisive_test.action: scripts/run_t20260930_13_intraday_periodicity.py extract (2023-08..2026-09 minute bars, P1500 ever-members, both shard layouts merged) then screen (12 candidates x 4 windows, ordinary and Newey-West 5-lag t, 100-seed same-pool placebo for all cells, adjacent-period control, r_C1/r_C2 split, RT1 and 1x/2x/frozen costs, by-year, mechanical tier) under run_capped 1.8G; results.json.
cheapest_decisive_test.falsification_condition: Per decision cell (C_L20_P1500, O_L20_P1500) in the 2024-01-08..2026-09-29 window: gross mean m < RT1, or Newey-West t < 2.0, or placebo beat < 0.90 closes that cell. Both closed closes same-period periodicity as an independent return source.
cheapest_decisive_test.pass_condition: Per decision cell: m >= 2 x RT1 (RT1 = long leg h + 4 bp plus short leg h + 4 bp, mean over selected names per day) with Newey-West t >= 2.0 and placebo beat >= 0.90. Marginal RT1 <= m < 2 x RT1 goes to a 200-name measured-quote sample (2x cost >= 0) before anything else.

cost_and_execution_assumptions: Closing segment: continuous-auction market entry at 15:30 (half spread h plus 2 bp), closing-auction cls exit before 15:50 ET (2 bp). Opening segment: opening-auction entry (DAY market before 09:28 ET, 2 bp), 10:00 continuous exit (h plus 2 bp). h = 0.5 x 21-day Abdi-Ranaldo spread (ml30.spread_estimate_from_ohlc, data before t). 2x stress: continuous 2h + 4 bp, auction 4 bp. Frozen 10/20 bp per side reported only. Shorts intraday only, easy-to-borrow proxy DTC quantile < 0.90 (T-32 load_dtc/attach_dtc), Alpaca ETB borrow fee 0. Alpaca docs opened 2026-09-30.
existing_solution_comparison: Heston-Korajczyk-Sadka 2010 (JF): same-half-hour decile spread 3.01 bp per half-hour, over 11 bp in the opening half hour, 8 bp in the last, on NYSE 2001-05, gross, with a 1.7 bp half spread as the cost benchmark; Haendler et al. 2025 abstract: pattern persists out of sample, open driven by VWAP trading, close by market-on-close flow. Nobody opened here tests it in 2024-26 with one auction leg. This repo has no signal card on half-hour periodicity; T-20260929-35 (C2a) tested the overnight leg on the same pool.
negative_experiments_checked: oc research directions check intraday periodicity close half-hour (2026-09-30): no registry direction on half-hour periodicity. Related negatives read: program line C closed single-symbol intraday rules; dir:intraday_reversal_reit_pwb (refuted); dir:overnight_intraday_gap_retail_pwb (refuted); T-20260929-32 (cross-sectional gap fade, refuted), T-20260930-11 and T-20260930-12 (auction check and small-cap gap-down long, refuted at 7.09 and -5.4 bp/day). Difference: half-hour cross-sectional ranking on the same-period past mean, entered or exited in an auction, not a gap or single-symbol rule.
objective: T-20260930-13 (C2b): in 2024-01-08..2026-09-29, do top-1500 dollar-volume US common stocks ranked by the past-20-day mean of the same half-hour return (opening 09:30-10:00, closing 15:30-16:00) keep a same-period long/short gross edge of at least 2 x RT1, with Newey-West t >= 2 and a same-pool random placebo beat >= 0.90, so that one auction leg per trade lowers the cost enough to pay?

remaining_evidence_gap: Not measured: quoted half spread at 15:30 and 10:00 (h is a daily Abdi-Ranaldo proxy, marginal tier needs 200 measured names), opening-auction impact of our orders, cls and opg fill reliability on the paper account, official opening price versus the daily-bar open (fat tail per T-11). Minute-data coverage and survivorship reported as the share of pool-days with minute bars; 2023 minute bars merge two shard layouts. Last-trade prices carry bid-ask bounce (noise, not a source of continuation at a one-day lag).

sources.claim: Heston, Korajczyk and Sadka (JF 2010, arXiv 1005.3535): a stock return in a half-hour interval is positively related to its return in the same half-hour interval on each of the previous 40 trading days; the Day 1 decile long/short earns 3.01 bp per half-hour at the same time next day, over 11 bp in the opening half-hour and averaging 1.75 bp over the rest of the day.
sources.core_claim: Heston, Korajczyk and Sadka (JF 2010, arXiv 1005.3535): a stock return in a half-hour interval is positively related to its return in the same half-hour interval on each of the previous 40 trading days; the Day 1 decile long/short earns 3.01 bp per half-hour at the same time next day, over 11 bp in the opening half-hour and averaging 1.75 bp over the rest of the day.
sources.independent_replication: Haendler-Heston-Korajczyk-Sadka 2025 report the pattern persists out of sample.
sources.limitations: 2001-2005 sample; gross of costs (the paper compares 3 bp with a 1.7 bp half quoted spread for S&P 500 names); the arXiv snapshot was pdftotext of the full paper, tables were not re-derived here.

stop_condition: Frozen in hypotheses.md: a decision cell is closed if m < RT1, Newey-West t < 2.0 or placebo beat < 0.90; passing needs m >= 2 x RT1 and both other gates; marginal goes to measured-quote sampling. Both cells closed closes same-period periodicity as an independent source (diagnostic remains only as a timing reference if the closing-period t >= 2). No change to pool, signals, windows, gates or costs after seeing results.
target_regime_and_horizon: Main window 2024-01-08 to 2026-09-29 (decision); selection window 2023-09-18 to 2025-12-31; contaminated holdout 2026-01-02 to 2026-09-17; new holdout 2026-09-18 to 2026-09-29 (listed only). Stress period 2016-2023 (sip-hist) read only after a cell passes. Holding period one half hour (09:30-10:00 or 15:30-16:00). A gross-edge measurement; a pass licenses stress period, measured quotes, ledger and a forward shadow, not trading. Validity ends if the forward 63-session gross mean falls below the tier threshold.
